name: @maison-tavo/theme
description: Maison Tavo live storefront — customized Horizon (Liquid)

scripts.ship: bun run build && bun run verify && shopify theme push -e production
scripts.dev: bun run prepare:upload && shopify theme dev -e development
scripts.push: bun run prepare:upload && shopify theme push -e production
scripts.push:unpublished: bun run prepare:upload && shopify theme push -e development --development
scripts.share: bun run prepare:upload && shopify theme share -e development
scripts.lint: bun scripts/design-lint.mjs && bun scripts/verify-js-chain.mjs && shopify theme check
